diagnosis.reasoning: Arrival load actually fell (request rate -86%, prompt token rate roughly flat), so this is not a capacity story, yet prefix cache hit rate and cached token ratio collapsed by ~92%, forcing nearly every prompt token to be recomputed (prefill_kv_computed_p99 ~4395 on ~4453-token prompts). That cache collapse directly explains the downstream KV usage spike, elevated prefill cost, queue buildup, and shrunken running batch/token throughput. Prefill cost, KV pressure and queueing are effects on the path to TTFT, and preemption never fired, so the prefix-cache mechanism is the root defect.
